title: Beyond Teacher Assignment: Domain-Normalized Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning can turn one language model into several specialists, each excellent at a single skill such as mathematics, coding or following instructions, but users need one model with all of these skills. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) merges them by letting the specialists teach one student: the student answers each prompt, and the specialist for that prompt's domain gives feedback on every token. analysis.detail_brief: Reinforcement learning can turn one language model into several specialists, each excellent at a single skill such as mathematics, coding or following instructions, but users need one model with all of these skills. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) merges them by letting the specialists teach one student: the student answers each prompt, and the specialist for that prompt's domain gives feedback on every token.

title: Learning to Learn from Context: Synthetic Training from Perturbed Public Documents
summary: Real-world tasks often require large language models (LLMs) to learn from complex task-specific context rather than pretrained parametric knowledge. Public high-quality documents are an abundant alternative, but much of the public web has already been consumed during pretraining: training on such documents naively would reward memorization rather than context learning. summary_cn: Learning to Learn from Context: Synthetic Training from Pert：现实世界的任务通常需要大型语言模型（LLM）来从复杂的特定于任务的上下文中学习，而不是预先训练的参数知识。这种能力仍然是法学硕士的弱点，而此类任务上下文的人工注释成本高昂且难以扩展。
